name: Precision Electronics Limited
about: Precision Electronics Limited designs and manufactures communication and electronics products and solutions in India. The company offers tactical masts, including push up, pneumatic, section based, winch, and lead screw masts, as well as tactical lighting systems, vehicular roof-top masts, and building roof-top masts. It also provides pedestals comprising rotators and pan tilts; multi-utility junction boxes and power supplies; and tripods that include light-, medium-, and heavy-duty tripods, as well as elevator tripods. In addition, the company offers accessories such as base plates, tilting cups, nails, hammers, guy ropes, pegs, and erection stands; DE spanners, adjustable spanners, pliers, box spanners with T-handles, Teflon tape, screwdrivers, steel oil cans, Velcro cable straps for cable ties, levels, Allen keys, guy markers, and nail pullers; pneumatic controller units, foot pumps, air compressors, and gimbals; earthing kits, lightning arrestors, and sand kits; FRPs, roto moulds, plastic injection mouldings, canvas bags, and corrugated bags; dual mounts, interface adapters, tripod adapters, dual payloads, circular heavy-duty brackets, side-mounting payloads, and payload adapters. Further, it provides SIGINT cellular surveillance and geolocation systems, as well as private LTE/5G network solutions, including TDM traffic over IP networks, RF over fiber converters, and small form-factor pluggable transceivers. Precision Electronics Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Noida, India.
